visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a pair of hands wearing a dark blue jacket adjusting the seat of a bright yellow electric bicycle. The bike is parked on a pavement scattered with fallen autumn leaves. (2) The camera pans up to show a person wearing a grey helmet and dark sunglasses getting ready. They are dressed in a dark grey jacket and have a tan crossbody bag with a yellow plush bird attached to it. They successfully mount the yellow bike while a companion with a red bicycle stands nearby on the asphalt road. (3) The scene transitions to a medium-long shot of the person riding the yellow electric bike down a paved road. The road is bordered by a tall stone retaining wall. The person looks over their shoulder briefly before pedaling forward into the distance.
